theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.summary: Former Congressman George Santos agreed to pay more than $35,000 to settle allegations he manipulated a wager on prediction market platform Kalshi about whether he’d attend the 2026 State of the Union.

top_news.summary: Following earnings this week that saw tech giants like Microsoft and Amazon report aggressive AI spending plans, EZ Primary Research CEO Ed Zitron gives his more skeptical take on the industry. top_news.title: Branches of K-Shaped Economy Diverging Even Wider: Clarida
top_news.summary: Former Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Richard Clarida, and now a global economic adviser for Pimco, talks to Tom Keene and Scarlet Fu on"Bloomberg Money". Clarida endorsed the view that the US has a so-called K-shaped economy, with the divergence between its two branches widening over the past six to seven years.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Jake Paul on Landmark Merger Between MVP, PFL To Take on the UFC
top_news.summary: Jake Paul's combat-sports company Most Valuable Promotions is merging with the Professional Fighters League, aiming to take on the Ultimate Fighting Championship. Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick & Vanessa Perdomo sat down with Jake Paul and Nakisa Bidarian, co-founders of Most Valuable Promotions, and John Martin, CEO of the newly formed company, to discuss the merger, and the roadmap ahead for the new company. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Warsh Reportedly Considering Reducing Number of Fed Meetings
top_news.summary:
Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is considering reducing the frequency of the central bank’s scheduled policy meetings, the New York Times reported Friday.
Warsh raised the proposal to change the frequency of meetings at this week’s gathering of the Federal Open Market Committee, the paper added.
Bloomberg Managing Editor Kate Davidson said changing the schedule would be the biggest change for Warsh. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Americans Are Richer Than Ever. Why Are They So Angry?
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Allison Schrager and David Gura join Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Schrager writes that "it is one of the great paradoxes of our time: Americans have never been richer — or more negative about the economy. More people are upper-middle class than ever, and even lower-income Americans are richer by almost every measure compared to previous generations. And yet more than three in five Americans say the economy is not working for them." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for July 31
top_news.summary: Oil posted its biggest monthly gain since March as traders grappled with simmering global conflicts and threats to supply from the Persian Gulf to the Black Sea.

top_news.title: New Zealand Housing Market Faces Biggest ‘Down Phase’ in Decades
top_news.summary: New Zealand house prices fell to a three-year low in July, extending a slump that began in early 2022 and leaving the market in its weakest state in decades.
